name: @wxyc/metadata-no-match-digest
description: Daily EC2-cron digest: reads the cronjob_runs watermark, queries flowsheet for rows that flipped to metadata_status='enriched_no_match' since the last run (filtered/sorted on updated_at, never metadata_attempt_at -- the live CDC enrichment worker deliberately leaves that NULL on no-match rows), and emails a digest to DIGEST_RECIPIENT_EMAIL: catalog/rotation-linked misses listed in full, freeform misses aggregated by artist, each line with a synthesized Discogs search URL. Zero misses sends no email but still advances the watermark. Read-only against flowsheet; no schema migration.
